saw_lines: Hair buyers rarely switch masks. They find the one that fixes their breakage, then reorder it for months without comparing.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a buyer decides if the problem is theirs.
Your site shows 7723 reviews on the 10 minute hair mask, yet none of your 30 ads use that number. Lead the mask ads with 7723 reviews and a customer quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 7723 reviews on the 10 minute hair mask, yet none of your 30 ads use it. Buyers want proof before the click, so that gap costs sales. Lead the mask ads with 7723 reviews and a customer quote.

Claim words like clinically sit in 8 of 29 ads. A cold buyer reads them as hype and scrolls past, so the claim loses attention. Swap them for what customers noticed in the first week, like softer ends from the mask.
Creator posts run as brand ads

Four of your 29 ads are creator posts run from the brand page. A cold buyer trusts a customer voice more than a logo. Whitelist the mask post from the creator’s account, then cut three variations of it.

Your 29 copy ads use 20 different openings, and the biggest opens 5 of them. Each new opener starts from zero. Pick two, starting with the surface and follicle line, and build the next batch from them.
